content.title: NTRA Q3 Deep Dive: Oncology Momentum and New Product Expansion Drive Guidance Increase
content.summary: Genetic testing company Natera (NASDAQ:NTRA). beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 34.7% year on year to $592.2 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.22 billion at the midpoint came in 6.1% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP loss of $0.64 per share was 74.5% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
